messages:
maya: Quick kickoff  planning a developer-first launch: small refapp + short benchmark story + hands-on webinar. Goal: dev signups + qualified inbound. who wants which piece?
sam: i'll own tutorial + repo. keep labs tiny: local run -> profile -> deploy to Hosted.
ton y: i'll produce perf numbers and a short narrative. will include p50/p95 and cost-per-1k tokens.
elena: i'll handle landing copy + form + routing. two CTAs: 'Try refapp' and 'Register workshop'.
kai: visuals for hero + 2 charts. need exact numbers.
maya: timeline target publish 2026-04-14. drafts: tutorial by 4/1, benchmark by 4/3, landing by 4/6, slides 4/9. dry-run 4/10.
ton y: baseline: p95 ~420ms, tuned: ~120ms, cost/1k baseline $1.80 -> tuned $0.55. will upload CSV.
sam: will include runnable commands, e.g.:```bash
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/llama-13b-q4 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --cache off
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/llama-13b-q4 --seq 4096 --batch 8 --cache on --quant q4
```
elena: routing plan: Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> tag contacts (refapp-workshop, benchmark-interest) -> SDR queue; post to #inbound-leads.
ops-bot: Zapier webhook test passed.
kai: i'll mock charts by EOD tomorrow. one p95 line chart + one cost-eff bar.
maya: webinar format 45m: 25m demo/tutorial, 15m Q&A, 5m CTAs. panel = tony + sam + elena. practice run 4/10.
elena: adding hidden campaign_id and Dedicated interest filter to zap.
maya: recap owners: sam=tutorial/repo, tony=bench, kai=visuals, elena=landing/routing/copy, maya=post + host. ping when drafts up. :rocket:
